arxiv-2103-08805.title: DDuo : General-Purpose Dynamic Analysis for Differential Privacy
arxiv-2103-08805.creator: Chike Abuah, Alex Silence, David Darais, Joe Near
arxiv-2103-08805.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chike Abuah, Alex Silence, David Darais, Joe Near. Differential privacy enables general statistical analysis of data with formal guarantees of privacy protection at the individual level. Tools that assist data analysts with utilizing differential privacy have frequently taken the form of programming languages and libraries. However, many existing programming languages designed for compositional verification of differential privacy impose significant burden on the programmer (in the form of complex type annotations).

The impurities interact with the fermions via a two-body potential λ ​ v ​ ( x ) \lambda v(x) where λ \lambda is a coupling constant and v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) for instance a screened Coulomb potential.

arxiv-2208-11537.title: PeRFception: Perception using Radiance Fields
arxiv-2208-11537.creator: Yoonwoo Jeong, Seungjoo Shin, Junha Lee, Christopher Choy, Animashree Anandkumar, Minsu Cho, Jaesik Park, POSTECH NVIDIA Caltech
arxiv-2208-11537.description: Abstract The recent progress in implicit 3D representation, i.e., Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), has made accurate and photorealistic 3D reconstruction possible in a differentiable manner. This new representation can effectively convey the information of hundreds of high-resolution images in one compact format and allows photorealistic synthesis of novel views.

arxiv-2405-16672.title: Transfer Learning Under High-Dimensional Graph Convolutional Regression Model for Node Classification
arxiv-2405-16672.creator: Jiachen Chen, Danyang Huang, Liyuan Wang, Kathryn L. Lunetta, Debarghya Mukherjee, Huimin Cheng
arxiv-2405-16672.description: Abstract Node classification is a fundamental task, but obtaining node classification labels can be challenging and expensive in many real-world scenarios. Transfer learning has emerged as a promising solution to address this challenge by leveraging knowledge from source domains to enhance learning in a target domain.

arxiv-2504-17903.title: Delayed and Displaced: The Impact of Binary Interactions on Core-collapse SN Feedback
arxiv-2504-17903.creator: Tom Wagg, Julianne J. Dalcanton, Mathieu Renzo, Katelyn Breivik, Matthew E. Orr, Adrian M. Price-Whelan, Akaxia Cruz, Alyson Brooks, Ulrich P. Steinwandel, Eric C. Bellm
arxiv-2504-17903.description: Abstract Core-collapse supernova feedback models in hydrodynamical simulations typically assume that all stars evolve as single stars. However, the majority of massive stars are formed in binaries and multiple systems, where interactions with a companion can affect stars’ subsequent evolution and kinematics.

arxiv-2507-04221.title: Context Tuning for In-Context Optimization
arxiv-2507-04221.creator: Jack Lu, Ryan Teehan, Zhenbang Yang, Mengye Ren
arxiv-2507-04221.description: Abstract We introduce Context Tuning , a simple and effective method to significantly enhance few-shot adaptation of language models (LLMs) without fine-tuning model parameters. While prompt-based adaptation techniques have demonstrated the effectiveness of lightweight adaptation methods for large language models (LLMs), they typically initialize a trainable prompt or prefix with irrelevant tokens for the task at hand.

arxiv-2509-26168.title: Localised Arrowheads: The building blocks of elastic turbulence in rectilinear, sheared polymer flows
arxiv-2509-26168.creator: Theo Lewy, Rich R. Kerswell
arxiv-2509-26168.description: Abstract Pressure-driven flow of a dilute polymer solution has been numerically observed to possess a form of elastic turbulence which is organised around the interactions of localised versions of 2-dimensional ‘arrowhead’ travelling waves (Page et al. Phys. Rev. Lett. 125 , 154501, 2020).

arxiv-2512-15867.title: HEPTAPOD: Orchestrating High Energy Physics Workflows Towards Autonomous Agency
arxiv-2512-15867.creator: Tony Menzo, Alexander Roman, Sergei Gleyzer, Konstantin Matchev
arxiv-2512-15867.description: Abstract Abstract Many workflows in high-energy-physics (HEP) stand to benefit from recent advances in transformer-based large language models (LLMs). While early applications of LLMs focused on text generation and code completion, modern LLMs now support orchestrated agency : the coordinated execution of complex, multi-step tasks through tool use, structured context, and iterative reasoning.

pmc-11483991.title: ADAMTS4 exacerbates lung cancer progression via regulating c-Myc protein stability and activating MAPK signaling pathway
pmc-11483991.creator: Wei Zhai, Wensheng Yang, Jing Ge, Xuelian Xiao, Kang Wu, Kelin She, Yu Zhou, Yi Kong, Lin Wu, Shiya Luo, Xingxiang Pu
pmc-11483991.description: BackgroundLung cancer is one of the most frequent cancers and the leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide with poor prognosis. A disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin motifs 4 (ADAMTS4) is crucial in the regulation of the extracellular matrix (ECM), impacting its formation, homeostasis and remodeling, and has been linked to cancer progression.

pmc-12580774.title: Understanding Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction From a Scientometric Perspective: How Is the Global Research Activity and Collaboration Going?
pmc-12580774.creator: Boshen Shu, Shufeng Zhang, Jian Gao, Lin Wang, Xiaohui Wang
pmc-12580774.description: ObjectiveUreteropelvic junction obstruction (UPJO) has been identified as the most prevalent cause of prenatally diagnosed hydronephrosis, characterized by a reduction in urine flow from the renal pelvis into the ureter. Management of this condition poses a significant clinical challenge, given the difficulty in differentiating between mild and benign cases and those with the potential to progress to severe renal impairment.

pmc-12655203.title: Social Isolation Among Individuals with Incontinence: A Scoping Review

pmc-13248961.description: Pregnancy complicated by thalassemia, especially in transfusion-dependent thalassemia (TDT) patients, poses major obstetric challenges. Long-term transfusions increase the risks of alloimmunization and autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA).

pmc-13411121.creator: Arie Dwi Alristina, Éva Kovács, Diyah Arini, Helga Judit Feith
pmc-13411121.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? pmc-13641117.title: A comparative analysis of artificial intelligence generated 3d facial models from 2D photos: A procrustes-based validation of landmark accuracy in Orthodontics
pmc-13641117.creator: Jonas Bianchi, Lorena Wilka, Gabriel Bravo Vallejo, Felicia Miranda, Camila Massaro, Lucia Cevidanes, Heesoo Oh
pmc-13641117.description: Objectives:The primary aim of this study was to evaluate the accuracy and precision of a deep learning artificial intelligence (AI) model in reconstructing 3D facial geometry from a single 2D photograph. The study specifically measured the coordinate differences of human-placed facial landmarks on the AI-generated models against those placed on 3D models from a gold-standard scanner (Bellus 3D).
